id: title:jurajmajerik:add tool role and structured tool calls to playground messages

review.posthog_relevance: Adds frontend components and tests for an AI agent tool-call editor and display, including backend message formatting and argument substitution. This could support debugging or demonstration of AI agent tool use, though no backend or production ingestion is shown.
review.reason: Adds snapshot entries and component implementations for message tool calls editor and tool call display, including backend message formatting and argument substitution. This could support debugging or demonstration of AI agent tool use, though no backend or production ingestion is shown.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned as 1 because the implementation of the backend OpenAI formatter and the actual tool-call handling is not shown; the chunk is dominated by frontend UI and test updates. The tier cannot be established without the actual implementation of the tool-call handling and the backend changes.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the MessageToolCallsEditor and ToolCallDisplay components, nor the backend OpenAI formatter implementation. The frontend hunks show UI changes and test updates, while the backend hunks show test updates. Without the actual implementation of the tool-call handling and the backend changes, the tier cannot be established.
